scope: code, isolated synthetic tests, release/rollback rehearsal only

tests.required_assertions: 两张卡归属、额度独立

tests.scenario: 多 Key 同用户同组
tests.required_assertions: 共用一张卡，不能每 Key 重发额度

tests.scenario: 空、零、负、NaN、Infinity、科学计数
tests.required_assertions: 拒绝且不写父记录、卡或操作

tests.scenario: 省略额度选有效套餐
tests.required_assertions: 精确复制默认值，改套餐不改旧卡

tests.scenario: 省略额度且无默认
tests.required_assertions: QUOTA_REQUIRED，无不限额路径

tests.scenario: 同幂等键重复开卡
tests.required_assertions: 一张卡，原响应和原时间不变

tests.scenario: 同目标同幂等键更改金额或套餐
tests.required_assertions: 409，不追加；不同身份 scope 不返回他人结果

tests.scenario: 同用户同时两次续卡
tests.required_assertions: 串行排期不重叠，term_no 唯一

tests.scenario: stale expected_revision
tests.required_assertions: 409，保留输入但不写入

tests.scenario: 到期前、到期瞬间、到期后
tests.required_assertions: 左闭右开；精确 168 小时

tests.scenario: 取消未来中间卡
tests.required_assertions: 后续卡不自动前移，无结转

tests.scenario: 耗尽后提前续卡
tests.required_assertions: 新卡按队尾生效，不能提前消费

tests.scenario: 同用户 GPT 与 Claude 交错请求
tests.required_assertions: 两账本各自变化，另一侧精确零变更

tests.scenario: GPT 额度零、Claude 有额
tests.required_assertions: Claude 可调用，GPT 原错误

tests.scenario: Claude 耗尽、GPT 有额
tests.required_assertions: GPT 可调用，Claude 429

tests.scenario: 任一订阅过期或取消
tests.required_assertions: 另一订阅仍正常，无余额回退

tests.scenario: 已绑定 GPT 使用普通其他组
tests.required_assertions: 原拒绝仍在，不能借本修复绕过
tests.acceptance_note: Accepted at I1 on frozen F3; later billing and release iterations require regression.

tests.scenario: GPT 开通前已有合法 Claude Key
tests.required_assertions: 开通成功，Claude Key 和权益不被覆盖
tests.acceptance_note: I1 compatibility evidence only. Full issued-card, accounting, endpoint or activation scenario remains in later iterations; see coordinator-I1-review.md.

tests.scenario: GPT 续费时有 Claude Key
tests.required_assertions: 续费成功，不删除 Key 或取消卡
tests.acceptance_note: I1 compatibility evidence only. Full issued-card, accounting, endpoint or activation scenario remains in later iterations; see coordinator-I1-review.md.

tests.scenario: GPT 首次开通普通余额非零
tests.required_assertions: 原前置检查仍生效
tests.acceptance_note: Accepted at I1 on frozen F3; later billing and release iterations require regression.

tests.scenario: GPT 加量、四周期、自动重置
tests.required_assertions: 原卡期、次数、额度、流水语义保持
tests.acceptance_note: I1 compatibility evidence only. Full issued-card, accounting, endpoint or activation scenario remains in later iterations; see coordinator-I1-review.md.

tests.scenario: GPT HTTP、SSE、WS 跨周期
tests.required_assertions: 原 durable receipt 和恢复行为不变

tests.scenario: 新模块关闭、仓库未注入
tests.required_assertions: Claude term 拒绝，GPT 不调用新领域 Repo
tests.acceptance_note: I1 compatibility evidence only. Full issued-card, accounting, endpoint or activation scenario remains in later iterations; see coordinator-I1-review.md.

tests.scenario: 入参伪造其他 user/group/term
tests.required_assertions: DTO 和复合 FK 拒绝跨归属写入

tests.scenario: 同凭据并发 Apply
tests.required_assertions: 一条 debit、一次用量和一次 Key/账号计数

tests.scenario: 已归档 dedup 重放
tests.required_assertions: 不第二次扣费，校验原 fingerprint

tests.scenario: 零费用
tests.required_assertions: 有明确来源和 settled 事实，不写普通余额

tests.scenario: 同一请求不同费用
tests.required_assertions: 冲突并告警，原事实不覆盖

tests.scenario: 客户端重复 Request-ID 两次真实调用
tests.required_assertions: 两个服务器消费身份，正常分别计费

tests.scenario: 部分来源字段恶意混填
tests.required_assertions: 四种来源互斥，零费用不能绕过

tests.scenario: 等锁跨到期或下一期起点
tests.required_assertions: 回滚重选，不拿旧卡加新时间

tests.scenario: 请求结束时旧卡已过期
tests.required_assertions: 仍记旧卡，新卡用量零变化

tests.scenario: 请求结束前当前卡被取消
tests.required_assertions: 已准入费用仍记原卡

tests.scenario: 上游后、known receipt 前崩溃
tests.required_assertions: admitted 转待核查，不猜零、不补扣 GPT

tests.scenario: known receipt 后、Apply 前崩溃
tests.required_assertions: 恢复后精确结算一次

tests.scenario: Apply 提交后进程崩溃
tests.required_assertions: 重放不再扣；日志可补写

tests.scenario: 流断连且 usage 已知
tests.required_assertions: 正常结算，断连不是退款

tests.scenario: usage 缺失、迟到与人工核查竞争
tests.required_assertions: NULL 与 reconcile_required；当前卡暂停新请求，旧卡不阻塞新卡；不产生假零账单

tests.scenario: 恢复首笔超时
tests.required_assertions: 后续条目用独立 context 继续

tests.scenario: 两恢复 worker 与租约到期
tests.required_assertions: 最多一次业务效果，未持 request 锁等待 scope
八位金额逐表精确一致

tests.scenario: 套餐或倍率在请求中途变化
tests.required_assertions: 使用冻结定价；恢复不按现价重算

tests.scenario: 账本提交、usage_log 写失败及日志清理
tests.required_assertions: 未写成功可补；已确认后清理不补回；不重新计费

tests.scenario: 多个在途请求超过额度、known 尚未 Apply
tests.required_assertions: 已知待结算计入准入判断；原卡真实已用可超额，不抹账或转下一期

tests.scenario: Messages、Chat、Responses 及全部别名
tests.required_assertions: 流式和非流式均有准入快照和结算

tests.scenario: 跨组 fallback、强制平台、未支持收费入口
tests.required_assertions: 明确拒绝，GPT 原能力仍正常
tests.acceptance_note: I1 compatibility evidence only. Full issued-card, accounting, endpoint or activation scenario remains in later iterations; see coordinator-I1-review.md.

tests.scenario: 慢预览、关闭 A 打开 B、A 的 finally 迟到
tests.required_assertions: B 不被旧结果覆盖

tests.scenario: 页面倒计时到零且网络未返回
tests.required_assertions: 不自行发额度、清零或假装已重置

tests.scenario: 中英文、窄屏、键盘、多个 Key
tests.required_assertions: 所有页面同一额度来源，Key 限额另标

tests.scenario: 下单后修改、下架或删除套餐
tests.required_assertions: 按订单原额度履约

tests.scenario: 支付回调并发、重试、租约交接
tests.required_assertions: 一个订单只创建一张卡

tests.scenario: 开卡事务失败后回调重试
tests.required_assertions: 不重复扣款或重复开卡，状态可恢复

tests.scenario: 无快照旧订单遇新模式分组
tests.required_assertions: 显式失败待处理，不猜额度

tests.scenario: reset、extend、restore、bulk、兑换及旧维护 worker
tests.required_assertions: 未适配动作拒绝，旧维护排除 term，已用及卡期不变
tests.acceptance_note: I1 compatibility evidence only. Full issued-card, accounting, endpoint or activation scenario remains in later iterations; see coordinator-I1-review.md.

tests.scenario: 旧式自动全额/部分退款及取消
tests.required_assertions: term 旧退款路径拒绝，不减父记录天数冒充撤销额度，不充值普通余额
tests.acceptance_note: I1 compatibility evidence only. Full issued-card, accounting, endpoint or activation scenario remains in later iterations; see coordinator-I1-review.md.

tests.scenario: 空库和旧二开库迁移、重复执行
tests.required_assertions: 约束正确，既有迁移校验和不变
tests.acceptance_note: Accepted at I1 on frozen F3; later billing and release iterations require regression.

tests.scenario: 新字段默认值及旧数据查询
tests.required_assertions: 全部旧组 windows，GPT 行为不改变
tests.acceptance_note: Accepted at I1 on frozen F3; later billing and release iterations require regression.

tests.scenario: 旧 auth cache 命中、新模式切换
tests.required_assertions: 旧版本失效，陈旧允许不越过最终 DB 检查
tests.acceptance_note: I1 compatibility evidence only. Full issued-card, accounting, endpoint or activation scenario remains in later iterations; see coordinator-I1-review.md.

tests.required_assertions: 无锁环，无全局重置锁竞争
tests.acceptance_note: I1 compatibility evidence only. Full issued-card, accounting, endpoint or activation scenario remains in later iterations; see coordinator-I1-review.md.

tests.scenario: R2 关闭新准入回到 R1
tests.required_assertions: Claude 明确拒绝，已知账务可完成，GPT 正常

tests.scenario: 未升级副本仍服务时请求启用
tests.required_assertions: 启用门禁拒绝，不运行混合语义

tests.required_assertions: 必须排空，切换前后每个请求来源明确
